Dynamo Defeat Galaxy 1-0 on Penalty Kick

Houston Dynamo defeated LA Galaxy 1-0, with a penalty kick goal by Aliyu Ibrahim Santos securing the win. This victory marked the Dynamo's fourth consecutive shutout. The match took place at Shell Energy Stadium. The Galaxy failed to score despite multiple attempts.
